LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT KEVIN ELSNER'S MOTION TO CONTEST JOINT APPLICATION FOR ORDER DETERMINING GOOD FAITH OF SETTLEMENT BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT BONNIE HUYNH IS DENIED. THE JOINT APPLICATION FOR ORDER DETERMINING GOOD FAITH SETTLEMENT IS GRANTED. THE COURT FINDS THAT THE SETTLEMENT TO BE IN GOOD FAITH. THE COURT RECOGNIZES THAT OBTAINING POSSESSION IS IN FACT SOMETHING THAT WEIGHS IN FAVOR OF THE SETTLEMENT AND IS NOT ASSIGNING ANY VALUE. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER.
